label: Icelandic supplementary pension savings
field.name: Name
help.birthDay: Leave blank to use the last day of the birth month.
help.openingCapital: Enter the balance for voluntary supplementary savings only.
help.grossMonthlyPay: Use zero for existing savings with no further contributions. Reflect the employee contribution in your payroll or Icelandic tax settings.
help.employeeRate: The standard employer adds 2% of pensionable pay. The entered wage or tax settings determine the cost to shared cash.
help.contributionUntil: Leave blank to continue up to the taxable full withdrawal or end of the plan.
help.annualReturn: Enter a nominal return after fund and plan charges.
help.homeAmount: Enter the tax-free amount approved by Skatturinn for this account. The withdrawal is limited to the available balance.
help.ordinaryDate: From age 60. This pays the remaining balance as taxable pension income. Leave blank to keep it invested.
invalid.person: Select a person and check the birth month and day.
invalid.capital: Enter a finite, non-negative opening balance.
invalid.contributions: Check the pensionable pay, contribution rate and contribution end date.
invalid.return: Enter an annual return between −99% and 100%.
invalid.homeAmount: Enter a finite, non-negative approved amount.
invalid.homeDate: Enter an approved first-home amount and a payment date within the plan.
invalid.ordinaryDate: Choose a taxable withdrawal date in the plan on or after the 60th birthday.
invalid.order: The first-home withdrawal must occur by the taxable full withdrawal date.
